import data.glitch_lib

# Check if integrity verification is disabled or missing
check_disabled_integrity(attr) {
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
} else {
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(false|no|disable|disabled|off|0)$", attr.value.value)
}

integrity_check_attrs := {
    "check_signature",
    "gpgcheck",
    "gpg_check",
    "verify_checksum",
    "checksum_verify",
    "verify_signature",
    "signature_check",
    "enforce_checksum",
    "checksum_enforce",
    "validate_checksum",
    "checksum",
    "verify",
    "verify_ssl",
    "ssl_verify",
    "strict_host_key_checking",
    "verify_peer",
    "verify_host"
}

download_commands := {
    "get_url",
    "wget",
    "curl",
    "download",
    "fetch",
    "uri",
    "win_get_url",
    "community.general.get_url",
    "ansible.builtin.get_url",
    "ansible.builtin.uri",
    "archive",
    "unarchive",
    "get",
    "remote_file",
    "http_request",
    "package",
    "apt",
    "apt_key",
    "rpm_key",
    "yum",
    "dnf",
    "zypper",
    "pacman",
    "gem",
    "pip",
    "npm",
    "composer"
}

# Detect explicit disabling of integrity checks
Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    download_commands[lower(node.type)]

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]

    integrity_check_attrs[lower(attr.name)]
    check_disabled_integrity(attr)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - Integrity verification is explicitly disabled, allowing potential data corruption or tampering. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

# Detect missing integrity check when using external sources
Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]

    download_commands[lower(node.type)]

    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr_map := {lower(attr.name): attr | attr := attrs[_]}

    # Has URL/source attribute pointing to external resource
    has_external_source(attr_map)

    # Check if no integrity verification attribute is present
    not has_any_integrity_check(attrs)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_no_int_check",
        "element": node,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Missing support for integrity check - No integrity verification mechanism (checksum, signature, or hash) is provided for external resource. (CWE-353)"
    }
}

    attr_map[key]
    external_source_attrs[key]
    attr_map[key].value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("^(https?|ftp)://", attr_map[key].value.value)
}

external_source_attrs := {
    "url",
    "src",
    "source",
    "uri",
    "href",
    "location",
    "repo",
    "repository",
    "baseurl"
}

has_any_integrity_check(attrs) {
    attr := attrs[_]
    integrity_check_attrs[lower(attr.name)]
}

The rule expects attribute extraction via `glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)`, but Chef's IR structure may have attributes nested differently or not populated for these resource blocks.
